requirements.text: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
requirements.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

outcomes.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

nodes.question: What is the visible position of each mug relative to the headphones in the edited image, and is any mug visibly on their right?
nodes.criteria: Pass if at least one visible mug is clearly positioned to the right of the headphones. Fail only if the image clearly shows no mug to their right. Unknown if the mugs or headphones, or their relative positions, cannot be reliably distinguished. Describe the visible layout; do not infer source-object identity or movement from appearance or location alone.
nodes.binding: Compare the edited image's mugs with the headphones and report which mugs are left, right, or ambiguously positioned relative to them. This check establishes the visible final relation only, not whether a mug is the source mug or whether the requested edit is complete.

nodes.question: Does the visual comparison establish requested progress toward placing a mug to the right of the headphones, and is the requested right-side relation achieved?
nodes.criteria: Pass if a mug is visibly to the right of the headphones. Fail only if clear comparison establishes that no requested progress toward that relation occurred. Unknown if the comparison cannot establish whether the right-side relation or any relevant progress occurred. Partial progress requires evidence of movement toward the right-side relation, not merely movement in another direction or the presence of a mug on the right; do not require proving that the mug is the same source object.
nodes.binding: Use s1's layout observations as context, and independently compare source and edited layouts for the requested relation. State whether a mug is right of the headphones and, if not, whether visible evidence establishes movement toward that relation. Do not treat a right-side mug alone as proof of movement or source identity.

nodes.question: Is the mug visibly positioned to the right of the headphones?
nodes.criteria: Complete only when s1 and s2 establish a mug visibly to the right of the headphones. Partial only when s2 establishes movement toward that relation but it is not achieved. Absent only when s2 establishes no requested progress. Otherwise unknown; do not infer identity, movement, or completion from unsupported observations.
nodes.binding: Target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.. Reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones..

program.checker_template:
Execute ONE saved check. Return status, evidence, confidence (0 to 1 or null), and used_dependency_ids. You receive no reference label or optimizer feedback. Do not predict what the optimizer wants.
Support checks receive source and edited images. Inspect only the saved visual proposition and binding. When dependencies are supplied, use those ancestor observations as context and investigate the more specific proposition yourself; do not simply repeat the parent answer. Use pass/fail/unknown. A pass on a broad parent does not imply a nested check passes. Known negative evidence is usable; uncertain or missing evidence is unknown. Do not award requested completion credit to supporting facts.
The requested fulfillment readout receives NO images. Use ALL and ONLY saved support observations, the original instruction, rubric and saved composition criteria. Use complete/partial/absent/unknown. Mere texture or object presence must not silently establish whole-image conversion or a requested spatial relation. Known progress plus evidenced incompleteness may be partial; absence means no requested progress. Missing necessary evidence is unknown, never a fabricated failure or completion. Do not infer new visual facts.
used_dependency_ids must name every supplied dependency check_id exactly once in saved order (empty when none). Confidence is self-report, not calibrated correctness.

response.content: {"accepted":false,"reason":"The support checks do not reliably establish the requested change. s1 observes only the edited image’s final layout, while s2’s criteria require evidence of progress toward the relation and its binding asks for a source-versus-edited comparison that the saved question does not explicitly require. More importantly, s2 treats any mug to the right as pass, and fulfillment treats that as completion, although the instruction requests moving the mug; a final right-side mug alone does not establish that the requested edit occurred. The readout therefore can overclaim completion and cannot consistently distinguish no progress from partial progress."}

parsed.reason: The support checks do not reliably establish the requested change. s1 observes only the edited image’s final layout, while s2’s criteria require evidence of progress toward the relation and its binding asks for a source-versus-edited comparison that the saved question does not explicitly require. More importantly, s2 treats any mug to the right as pass, and fulfillment treats that as completion, although the instruction requests moving the mug; a final right-side mug alone does not establish that the requested edit occurred. The readout therefore can overclaim completion and cannot consistently distinguish no progress from partial progress.
